author: Arnav
problem: Read N. For each i from 0 to N, let s_i be the smallest divisor j of N with 1 <= j <= 9 such that i is a multiple of N/j, or '-' if there is none. Print s_0 s_1 ... s_N as one string.
bug_description: For N of 9 or more the divisor loop stops at 8 (range end 9 instead of 10), so the divisor 9 is never tried.

comments.accurate: Collects N's divisors from 1 to 9 and, for each i, picks the smallest one whose N/j divides i
comments.wrong_behavior: Collects N's divisors from 1 up to 8 and, for each i, picks the smallest one whose N/j divides i
comments.wrong_location: Divisor list verified; check i % (N / j) when N / j isn't a whole number

source.buggy_line: for i in range(1, num+1 if num < 9 else 9):
source.fixed_line: for i in range(1, num+1 if num < 9 else 10):
